## Understanding the VIN Structure for Your 2022 Maserati Quattroporte in Virginia

A VIN check for a 2022 Maserati Quattroporte in Virginia begins with decoding the 17-character identifier. The first three characters, the World Manufacturer Identifier (WMI), are critical. For this VIN, the WMI candidate "1HG" is a primary code to verify. The ninth character is a mandatory check digit used for mathematical validation to detect VIN tampering or transcription errors. Positions ten through seventeen reveal the model year, assembly plant, and the vehicle's unique serial number. This structured data forms the foundation for all subsequent history checks against the Virginia DMV's title-holding system and other records. A proper decode confirms the vehicle's core identity before searching for brands like Salvage or Rebuilt.
